label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Something is NECESSARY_PER_SE_2, not having the cause…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: Ergo necesse est ponere aliquid quod sit per se necessarium, non habens causam necessitatis aliunde, sed quod est causa necessitatis aliis
interpretation: Something is necessary per se. 'Causa necessitatis aliis' is read in the weakest form the argument gives: each necessary being is per se necessary or has its necessity, through a finite chain, from some per se necessary being. No uniqueness: the text does not show that one being is the source for all.
